## Trigger

What real failure, evidence, or model gap justifies this change?

## Current behavior

What does the current Protocol/router/skill/enforcement layer do?

## Proposed semantic change

Describe the smallest decision-relevant change.

## Why existing rules are insufficient

Point to the current canonical/runtime behavior that fails to cover the case.

## Impact analysis

Which files or concepts are affected?

- [ ] PROTOCOL.md
- [ ] AGENTS.md
- [ ] skill(s)
- [ ] runtime map / architecture docs
- [ ] evals
- [ ] enforcement / conformance
- [ ] other

## Proof

What fixture, eval, real-world case, or other evidence should show the change is correct?

## Anti-overengineering check

Why is a new rule/structure necessary instead of using or clarifying an existing one?
